children.name: Section - 8. About Us: Dedicated Intro to Smt. Ananya Kulkarni & Authentic Story
Text
children.characters:
Where Maharashtrian Heritage
Meets Heartfelt Craftsmanship.

children.name: Text
children.characters:
Ananya Creations began over a decade ago in the peaceful cultural heart of Pune. Rooted
in generational wisdom passed down by her grandmother, Smt. Ananya Kulkarni sought to
revive the delicate, fast-disappearing art of traditional floral wiring (फुलवेणी गुंफण) and sugar-
bead confectionery jewellery (हलव्याचे दागिने).

children.name: Text
children.characters:
What began as handcrafted adornments for family weddings soon blossomed into a
renowned home-based boutique celebrated across Maharashtra, Goa, and NRI families
globally. Every flower is selected personally at dawn from local Phool Mandis, treated with
organic floral hydration techniques, and strung by hand so that your jewellery remains
pristine through long ritual muhurtams.
